label: copy-phase input l (fed-back l), strongest mid-copy
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99.6% of mass) when the fed-back input is the letter l during the copy phase; never in the original or delimiter phase, and essentially never on any other input token (small residue on x/m/i). Only about 25% of copy-phase l inputs activate it, so precision is incomplete. Magnitude is modulated by position, peaking at recall_idx 3-4 (the l was original token 2-3), and by the token being output next: outputs i, m, x, d, h, 0 give the strongest activations (top examples are like o t l i m -> o t [l] i). Restricting to recall_idx 2-5 keeps 95% of mass with precision 0.36; adding an output-token set raises precision to about 0.75 but drops recall below 0.5, and no clean rule found.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=10: l, x, i, m; t=9: l, x, m, i; t=11: l, x, i, m) and the token being output (most: m, x, i, l, d, h; least: t, -, k, j); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=3 & t=4, L=3.
